Advertisement
Applications are invited from eligible candidates (Indian Nationals) for one (1) position of
Senior Project Assistant in an ICMR funded research project entitled, "Therapeutic
implications of fisetin loaded peptide nano-carriers against circadian disturbances in
prenatal VPA induced rodent model of autism" for a duration of three years sanctioned to
Dr. Mani Chopra, Cell and Molecular Biology laboratory, Department of Zoology, Panjab
University, Chandigarh.
Age limit: Maximum 28 years as on the date of interview. Age relaxation will be applicable as
per Government of India guidelines.
Duration: Initial appointment for one year, extendable up to three years or until project
completion, whichever is earlier, subject to satisfactory performance review.
Emoluments: ₹ 30,600/- consolidated per month.
Qualification:
Essential:
1. Graduate with minimum 60% marks in Science discipline from a recognized
university/institute along with 3 years of work experience in relevant subject/field
OR
Post-graduation in Zoology/Life Sciences with minimum 60% marks
2. Experience with animal handling, molecular biology techniques, laboratory
management
Desirable:
1. Experience in working with animal models of neurological disorders
2. Knowledge of nanoparticle characterization and EEG techniques
3. Understanding of drug delivery systems and data analysis software
NOTE:
1. Interested candidates meeting the above criteria should post the application on plain
paper with detailed CV, including photocopies of certificates and testimonial of
educational qualifications, research experience, and contact information to reach the
undersigned by 28/03/2025.
2. Shortlisting for interview will be done based on eligibility criteria.
3. Date for the interview will be intimated to shortlisted candidates through email.
4. Original documents will be verified at the time of interview.
5. Selection will be based on qualifications and performance in the interview.
6. No TA/DA will be provided for attending the interview.
7. The tenure of the above said post is co-terminus with the project duration.
Sd/-
Dr. Mani Chopra
